events.title: [FedCM] Use the modal for passive mode sign-up with multiple IdPs

description_changes.before: When FedCM asks for permission to share data with a site, shows links to the identity provider's account management page, privacy policy and terms of service, from the account_management_url, privacy_policy_url and terms_of_service_url keys of its well-known file. In passive mode with a single identity provider, FedCM then asks for this permission in a modal dialog instead of the bubble, so that the links are shown.
description_changes.after: When FedCM asks for permission to share data with a site, shows links to the identity provider's account management page, privacy policy and terms of service, from the account_management_url, privacy_policy_url and terms_of_service_url keys of its well-known file. In passive mode, FedCM then asks for this permission in a modal dialog instead of the bubble, so that the links are shown. With multiple identity providers, this also requires #fedcm-active-mode-multiple-identity-providers.
